PA-15.name: Ray Bilger
PA-15.evidence: Former Republican, Air Force/NSA veteran; 'not for donors or party or leadership', 'I have a lot of MAGA friends', 'not anti-fracking', practical 'guy who knows how to fix things' framing.

NY-18.name: Pat Ryan
NY-18.evidence: Incumbent pitching 'patriotic populism'; 2026 campaign attacks 'big mega companies' and billionaires, 'systemic corruption', pledges to be 'an independent voice', fight for 'the working class'; no explicit left or centrist caucus marker found.

SEN-IA.name: Josh Turek
SEN-IA.evidence: Self-described 'common sense prairie populist' in Harkin mold; economic-adversity personal story, insulin/healthcare costs, term limits and congressional stock-trading ban. 'Common sense' framing borders on centrist but no explicit moderate/Blue Dog marker.

FL-26.name: Nicole Locklin
FL-26.evidence: Campaign page: running 'to take on corruption', rejects corporate or foreign PAC money, 'a candidate for The People, not the powerful billionaire class', government that answers 'to voters, not donors'. No left-group endorsements found.

SPECIAL-GA-14-2026-04.name: Shawn Harris
SPECIAL-GA-14-2026-04.evidence: Retired Army brigadier general and cattle farmer ('work with my hands'); campaign on grocery prices and tariffs, party-backed (Warnock events). No explicit centrist or left marker in fetched sources.

TN-1.name: Kristi Burke
TN-1.evidence: First-time candidate, artist/organizer, 'big believer in people over power'; healthcare 'a human right', shift taxes onto corporations and the very wealthy; platform billed as anti-oligarchy/anti-corruption/pro-impeachment. No DSA/JD/OR markers found.

TX-37.name: Greg Casar
TX-37.evidence: Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, former labor organizer aligned with democratic socialists, 'Fighting Oligarchy' tour with Sanders; incumbent so posture mixed per brief.

MI-12.name: Rashida Tlaib
MI-12.evidence: Squad member, DSA-endorsed (2026 DSA candidate roundup); 'unbought and unapologetic', attacks big banks and corporations; four-term incumbent so posture mixed.

NY-11.name: Michael DeCillis
NY-11.evidence: Former NYPD officer/9-11 responder and teacher; 'Healthcare is a right', universal health care, raise corporate tax rate; described as mainstream progressive supporting Medicare for All but no Sanders/WFP/DSA backing found.

CT-4.name: Jim Himes
CT-4.evidence: Long-time incumbent, former New Democrat Coalition chair ('a modern Democrat'), Intelligence Committee ranking member; safe seat so New Dem membership alone -> liberal.

KY-2.name: Megan Wingfield
KY-2.evidence: Mechanic with automotive technology degree; 'People-First Economy' where one job supports a family, crack down on corporate price gouging, supports Medicare for All (no Sanders/OR/WFP backing found, so not left).

FL-5.name: Rachel Grage
FL-5.evidence: Top Democratic fundraiser in primary, affordability focus, prior state House run; no populist, left or centrist markers in fetched coverage.

MS-1.name: Cliff Johnson
MS-1.evidence: Civil rights attorney, Ole Miss MacArthur Justice Center director; 'too many career politicians have forgotten those values', grocery/gas prices, healthcare affordability; no explicit ideological label.
